blocks.text: P par particle ka acceleration aₚ circle ke centre (markaz) ki taraf hai (Fig. 14.7). Is ka horizontal component diameter ke saath hai, aur Q ka acceleration yahi horizontal component hai:
Centripetal acceleration aₚ = x₀ω² hai (centre ki taraf, is liye minus lagta hai) aur cosθ = x/x₀:

blocks.alt: Wahi circle, points A, B aur C. P ka centripetal acceleration ap, PO ke saath centre ki taraf hai. Is ka horizontal component a, Q par diameter BA ke saath O ki taraf act karta hai. Angle theta O aur P par likha hai, aur x distance OQ hai.

blocks.text: Minus ka nishaan batata hai ke acceleration hamesha mean position ki taraf hai.
Particle uniform angular frequency ω se ghoom raha hai, yani ω constant hai, is liye:

Yahi S.H.M ki condition (shart) hai: acceleration displacement ke directly proportional aur mean position ki taraf. Is se prove (sabit) hua ke jab particle circle ke kinare par ghoomta hai to us ki projection S.H.M karti hai.

blocks.title: Example 14.3
blocks.problem: 0.2 kg mass ek spring se bandha hai jis ka spring constant 10 N m⁻¹ hai. Mass ko equilibrium position se 0.1 m hata kar rest se chhora jata hai. Nikalein: (a) x = 0.05 m par acceleration (b) x = 0.05 m par velocity.
steps: Diya gaya: m = 0.2 kg, k = 10 N m⁻¹, amplitude x₀ = 0.1 m (yahin se chhora gaya). Pehle ω nikalein.
(a) a = −ω²x = −(7.07)² × 0.05 = −50 × 0.05 = −2.5 m s⁻². Minus: acceleration mean position ki taraf hai.
blocks.answer: a ≈ −2.5 m s⁻² aur v ≈ 0.612 m s⁻¹.

blocks.prompt: Amplitude x₀ wale S.H.M mein jab x = x₀/2 ho to speed maximum speed ka kitna hissa hoti hai?
blocks.explanation: v = ω√(x₀² − x₀²/4) = ω√(3x₀²/4) = (√3/2)x₀ω ≈ 0.87 vₘₐₓ. Yani aadhe raste par speed maximum ki taqreeban 87% hai (Example 14.3 mein 0.612/0.707 ≈ 0.87).

items: Circle mein uniform ghoomte particle ki diameter par projection S.H.M karti hai.
x = x₀cosωt; v = x₀ω sinωt (magnitude) = ω√(x₀² − x²); mean position par vₘₐₓ = x₀ω.
a = −ω²x: extreme positions par sab se zyada (x₀ω²), mean position par zero.
